reviews.text: Don’t know why it’s taken us this long to post a review! but we LOVE coming here! We’ve been coming here for years and love the staff. for the first couple of year we only brought in our two dogs, but have recently added a 3rd member to our pack. She’s a bit of a bigger breed, so we were a bit worried of how she’d behave with them since she was a rescue pup, the whole team was super helpful and gave us different options in case she was uncomfortable. safe to say our pup loves coming here now.  The dog in the pic is Mickey, he’s a reactive dog and i wouldn’t trust any other groomer with him they’re super sweet and patient with him which leaves me at ease every time!

We’ve been taking both of our dogs to Bark Out Loud for over 10 years, and we wouldn’t trust anyone else. Lisa is an amazing owner who truly cares about every dog. Even though we live in Santee, it’s absolutely worth the drive for the outstanding dog grooming and care. Highly recommend Bark Out Loud to anyone looking for a caring, reliable groomer!

AVOID AT ALL COSTS:

Due to the negligence of staff, my dog out of their establishment near a busy intersection after I dropped him off for a grooming appointment. The owner’s response was that I’m “lucky they even told me” since they could have easily lied about it and I never would have known.

When asked how this happened, the staff member was actually laughing and said “he’s such an escape artist.” Nothing about this is funny.

She said that he “pawed his way” out of a locked kennel (he’s a 25 lb mini Aussie). Between the kennel area and the front desk area, there is a sliding door, but their staff had haphazardly left that open, allowing him access to a third, poorly manufactured front door.

No dog should be able to get out of a fully-locked kennel, and no doors to the lobby/outside should be left open.

Not only were they negligent, but the owner was disrespectful and showed a completely lack of accountability or empathy, having put my dog in danger. He ran two blocks before they caught him, and I’m so happy to have him home.
Very friendly, great with dogs and affordable

My girl had a traumatic grooming situation (not at this place). This is the first groomers since then that she's not shaking as soon as we enter the door!  They are so sweet and amazing! She loves them and they are so kind to her. Love everyone here!
My two Chihuahuas got their nails done. It was quick and very reasonable. The place was extremely clean, the service was awesome I definitely would recommend it.
I loved their service and my dog ​​looked beautiful 🫶🏻 100% recommended …

My dog Lola does not like bring her nails cut. This groomer is soo kind and has a lot of patience with my whining dog. My dog does better with filing instead of the nail cutting tool and this groomer will accommodate! She is my go to when my dog needs her nails trimmed.

***DISCLAIMER***: I don’t have definitive evidence or even know for sure if what I’m about to say actually happened, however, I am extremely skeptical and want to raise awareness to bring your pets here with caution due to my experience.

I brought my dog here to be groomed about 5 or 6 times, and every single time I picked him up, he was extremely lethargic, sick and depressed for literally days. He’s normally always extremely energetic and happy, so this is very out of character for him.

The people seem friendly and the haircut was fine, so naturally I assumed that he was just sad and depressed because he got his hair cut off. Well, I recently moved to Japan from San Diego, so obviously I now have a new groomer…

At this new Japanese groomer, I pick him up and he’s the same little happy, energetic dog that he always is. He’s excited to see me when I pick him up and perfectly fine when we get home, no issues whatsoever like the ones before when I got him groomed at this place.

I am *almost* certain that they were giving my dog some type of drugs to keep him calm while he was being groomed, obviously without my consent. BE WARNED because I am not exaggerating in the least bit when I say there is a COMPLETE night and day difference with his demeanor when coming home from my new Japanese groomer compared to coming home from here.

I gave a 1 star review for the sheer skepticism just because I want to bring attention to my review. If your dog seems lethargic and is behaving oddly after leaving this place, take him to a different groomer and see if you have the same result before returning again.
They did an awesome job with my dog. I’m pleasantly pleased

I’ve been bringing my dog here since I lived in the neighborhood and my dog still prefers them over anyone else! We’ve moved to Escondido since, but this is still our favorite groomer in San Diego. They always do a great job and get her in and out as quickly as possible, even on the busiest Saturdays.

Fantastic and reasonably priced place to bring your pet, ours is a dog, for grooming.
We have taken Oreo here for a few years now and have always been more than satisfied with their care and abilities!  Our girl always comes back looking fantastic and so clean!

A bit over $100 after tax and 15% tip for full shave of 55lb dog.  Came out mostly good.  I mentioned to them to carefully remove feathers between his paws when I dropped him off and they did ok but not great with that.  The groom area is …
